verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or MCP endpoint. The OpenAI-compatible API, OpenAPI spec and Swagger UI are developer building blocks, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
